name: silver
description: The silver keyless browser for AI agents, installable straight from this repo.

plugins.name: silver
plugins.description: A keyless local headless browser for AI agents (Playwright; never calls a model or an API). Drives live pages through accessibility-tree snapshots with stable @eN refs. Ships the skill and the /quick, /extract, /parallel, /task commands; needs the `silver` CLI on PATH (npm i -g agent-silver).
